name: Customer PO Report
query:
SELECT

    so.name AS "SO ID:Link/Sales Order:150",

    so.transaction_date AS "SO Date:Date:120",

    si.po_no AS "Customer's PO No. :Data:170",

    si.po_date AS "Customer's PO Date :Date:170",

    so.status AS "Status",

    c.customer_code AS "Customer Code :Link/Customer:150",

    so.customer_name AS "Customer Name :Data:180",

    soi.party_item_code AS "Party Item Code :Link/Item:150",

    soi.item_code AS "Item Code :Link/Item:120",

    soi.item_name AS "Item Name :Data:180",

    soi.description AS "Description:Data:250",

    soi.qty AS "PO Quantity :Float:120",

    (soi.qty - IFNULL(soi.delivered_qty, 0)) AS "Available Qty.:Float:150",
 
    CONCAT(IFNULL(cur.symbol, so.currency), ' ', FORMAT(soi.rate, 2)) AS "Item Rate:Data:120",

    so.currency AS "Currency:Link/Currency:100",

    so.conversion_rate AS "Exchange Rate :Float:150",
 
    ROUND(so.total, 2) AS "PO Total:140",
 
    -- invoice Grand Total (per invoice)

    CONCAT(IFNULL(cur.symbol, so.currency), ' ', FORMAT(IFNULL(si.grand_total, 0), 2)) AS "Invoice Grand Total:Data:180",
 
    CONCAT(IFNULL(cur.symbol, so.currency), ' ', FORMAT(IFNULL(si.outstanding_amount, 0), 2)) AS "Outstanding Amount :Data:170",
 
    so.delivery_date AS "Delivery Date :Date:120",
 
    IFNULL(SUM(bin.actual_qty), 0) AS "Item Available Qty:Float",
 
    c.business_region_name AS "Business Region Name :Data:190",

    st.sales_person AS "Sales Person:Link/Sales Person:150",
 
    CASE

        WHEN IFNULL(a.country, '') = 'India' THEN 'Domestic'

        ELSE 'Export'

    END AS "Domestic/Export:Data:150"
 
FROM `tabSales Order` AS so

INNER JOIN `tabSales Order Item` AS soi ON soi.parent = so.name
 
LEFT JOIN `tabItem` AS i ON soi.item_code = i.name

LEFT JOIN `tabSales Team` AS st ON st.parent = so.name

LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` AS c ON so.customer = c.name

LEFT JOIN `tabAddress` a ON a.name = so.customer_address

LEFT JOIN `tabCurrency` cur ON cur.name = so.currency
 
LEFT JOIN `tabDynamic Link` dl

    ON dl.parent = so.shipping_address_name

    AND dl.parenttype = 'Address'

    AND dl.link_doctype = 'Customer'
 
LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` sc ON sc.name = dl.link_name
 
LEFT JOIN `tabBin` bin

    ON bin.item_code = soi.item_code

LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii

    ON sii.so_detail = soi.name
 
LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si

    ON si.name = sii.parent
 
WHERE

    so.docstatus = 1
 
GROUP BY

    soi.name
 
ORDER BY

    so.transaction_date DESC;
